text: Ruby's band is playing the Fleece on Friday. She sounded properly nervous about it, first gig with the new drummer. Text her good luck that afternoon. She also said her boyfriend is flying in from Dublin for it and they're doing brunch with her parents the next day, which she's slightly dreading because they've never met him.
Nikhil lives in Walthamstow now, just off the high street. Works for a logistics firm in Stratford.
Anjali turns 30 next Tuesday. She's been going on about wanting a proper pasta machine.
Zara and her husband Kai are running the Cardiff half this weekend. They've been training since June.
Varun's piano recital got cancelled because the hall flooded. He's rescheduled for after Christmas, date to be confirmed.
Caught Alejandro after the match. His son Mateo scored twice and he couldn't stop talking about it.
Caroline's mum is in the choir concert at the cathedral on Saturday. Caroline's going with her sister and I said I'd drive them.
Nadia works nights at the Royal Infirmary, A&E. Her partner is a teacher at the primary near the park.
Hemi has a new dog, a rescue greyhound called Biscuit. Very timid apparently.
Must ask Aurelio how the chess tournament went. It was on Sunday and he'd been preparing for weeks.
Aneesh mentioned his brother Darius is moving to Leeds in a fortnight for a new job at the BBC.
Bought tickets for the Arctic Monkeys show. Doors 7pm Thursday, need to leave work early.
Asha said her daughter's ballet show is the day before her birthday, so she's having a quiet one this year. I should send her a card anyway.

Pooja is obsessed with bouldering at the moment. Goes three times a week, wants new climbing shoes for her birthday next month. She's a size 6 and likes the La Sportiva ones, apparently the old pair have a hole in the toe. Her sister Zara said she'd go halves with me if I want, so I should message Zara this weekend.
Bruno grew up in Porto, moved here at nineteen. His parents still live there and he visits every summer.
Kwame's play opens tomorrow at the Old Vic. Don't forget to message him the next day to ask how opening night went.

Mariam and Sean are hosting a quiz night for their tenth anniversary on Saturday the 7th. I'm bringing dessert. Sean wants it to be a surprise for Mariam's parents too, who are coming down from Glasgow that morning and staying until the Monday. Teams of four, fancy dress optional, and there's a raffle for the local food bank afterwards.
Jakub failed his driving test again on Monday. Pretty gutted. Give it a couple of days and then check in on him.
Patrick's retiring at the end of the month after thirty years at the council. There's a do at the Red Lion that Friday.
Miriam is vegan and doesn't drink. Lives with her girlfriend in a flat above the bakery on Mill Road.

Catalina has her violin audition for the conservatoire next Wednesday. She's barely sleeping, poor thing. Wish her luck the night before and ask how it went afterwards. Her teacher thinks she's ready but she's convinced she'll freeze on the scales. Her mum is driving her down to London the day before and they're staying with an aunt in Ealing.
Esther's grandson is in the under-11s cup final this weekend. She's going to watch, says she'll bring a flask and a blanket.
Manon Moreau, the new manager at the café, is from Lyon. Has two teenage boys, both mad about rugby.
Hoang said his wife Kiri is expecting in March. Their first. He's thrilled and slightly terrified.

Eva's birthday is Thursday. She mentioned she's run out of her favourite candle, the fig one from that shop in town. Easy win. She's also been getting into pottery since she started the evening class with her friend Manon, so maybe a nice glaze set or a book could go with it. Party is at hers on Saturday, I'm on drinks duty.
Pick up dry cleaning, renew car insurance before Friday, and book the boiler service.
Ruby's brother Nikhil is doing the Great North Run in two weeks. She's going up to Newcastle to cheer him on and staying the night.
Anjali works in HR at a law firm in the City. Lives in Clapham with two flatmates. Her parents are in Leicester.

Long chat with Zara on the phone. Her dad, Uncle Varun to everyone, has his hip operation on Tuesday and she's flying back from Lisbon the day before to be with him. She's worried because he's not great with hospitals. I said I'd pop round with food the week after once he's home. Also she mentioned that her nephew's football tournament is that same weekend so it's all a bit chaotic.
Alejandro Fernández, Alex to everyone at work, is playing bass at the jazz night on Friday. Must go along and support.
Need to get something for Caroline before Saturday. She's been hinting about a new pair of running headphones, the bone conduction ones.
Nadia's cat Pickle went missing last week. Turned up yesterday, thin but fine. She was in bits.
Hemi's daughter is doing her Grade 5 cello exam tomorrow morning. Hemi says she's more nervous than her daughter is.
Aurelio is a sound engineer for touring bands. Spends half the year on the road, lives in Bristol when he's back.
Aneesh's darts team made the county final. It's next Saturday in Swindon and he's asked me to come along.
Aleksander Novak, the neighbour at number 12, has three kids and a huge Alsatian called Bruno. Works from home doing something in finance.

Darius' wedding is off. He and Asha split up last month. He seemed okay but quiet. Should take him for a pint sometime soon. He's moved back in with his parents for now while he looks for a flat, and he's thrown himself into training for the Ironman in May. His boss has been decent about it and given him a couple of weeks off.
Asha loves anything to do with Studio Ghibli. Collects the figures, has the posters, knows every film by heart.
Pooja and her husband are going to Glastonbury next summer, they finally got tickets this morning after six hours in the queue.

Bruno's running the Brighton marathon in April. He's been raising money for the hospice that looked after his gran. Remind me to sponsor him before payday runs out. He's already at £1,200 out of £2,000. His wife and their kids are going down to Brighton the night before to see him off, and they've booked a table at his favourite fish place afterwards to celebrate.
Kai said his little sister is graduating from Edinburgh on Thursday. The whole family is going up for the ceremony and a dinner afterwards.
Kwame lives in Peckham with his partner Miriam and their two kids. He's a structural engineer, she's a midwife.
My own half marathon is a week on Sunday. Rest day Saturday, carb load the night before, early night.

Mariam mentioned she's been struggling since her dad died in the summer. The memorial concert his old band is playing is on the 14th and she's dreading it. Check in with her that morning, and maybe send flowers the day after.
Sean's into vinyl, specifically old soul and Motown pressings. Birthday is the 22nd. Could find him something at the record fair on Sunday.
Jakub's daughter Eva starts at the Saturday drama school this weekend. Her first show will be at Christmas.

Spent the afternoon with Patrick and his wife Esther. Their grandson Hoang has his black belt grading in Manchester tomorrow and they're driving up first thing. Patrick mentioned they'd been to the same dojo when their son was little, and the instructor still remembers him. Esther said she's going to film the whole thing. I should ask them on Monday how he got on.
Catalina is from Bogotá originally. Lives in Hackney, teaches Spanish at the adult education centre on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Manon's son is playing in the school jazz band at the Christmas concert. She asked if I could come and I said yes.
Nothing much from today's catch-up with Ruby. Mostly moaned about the weather and the trains.
Mateo's band won the battle of the bands last night! Send him a congrats message.
Kiri's birthday is a week after the baby's due date, so she's asked for no fuss this year. Maybe a voucher for a massage later on.

Eva Andersson, Mrs A from the choir, told me her husband had a stroke on Friday. He's stable, in the Royal Free. The choir's winter concert is on the 12th and she's still hoping to sing, but she'll decide nearer the time. Ring her on Wednesday to see how he's doing.
Zara's twins have their first swimming gala on Saturday. Zara's more stressed about it than they are, she says.
Varun Jensen works as a pharmacist at the Boots on Market Street. Married to Nadia, who runs the yoga studio next door.
Aleksander and his partner are going to see Hamilton next Friday for their anniversary. He's booked dinner beforehand somewhere near the theatre.
Remind me to call Darius tomorrow. His band's gig at the Roundhouse was last night and I couldn't make it.
Gym at 7, then the farmers' market. Haven't decided about the cinema.
Nikhil's into F1 and cycling. Supports McLaren. His birthday is coming up in a fortnight and he hinted at a Rapha jersey.
Hoang's mum is having a cataract operation on Monday. He's taking her in and taking the rest of the week off. Text him that evening to see how it went, then again on Thursday.
